rtb.locator: RangeBearingSensor constructor, h, Hx and reading; RTB 1.4.4 local snapshots in author checks
rtb.finding: The implementation uses quadrant-aware bearing and the signed pose Jacobian. The animate keyword remains a deprecated alias for plot.

gaussian.locator: Notes on covariance and singular support
gaussian.finding: The ordinary inverse/determinant formula requires a nonsingular positive-definite covariance. Singular distributions need a separate extension.

lidar.finding: RPLIDAR A1 uses triangulation; the lecture’s pulsed time-of-flight model must not be generalized to every RPLIDAR model.

vehicle.finding: The q property returns vehicle state; f uses translate-then-rotate odometry.

map.locator: LandmarkMap constructor and workspace expansion table
map.finding: A scalar workspace A gives both coordinate bounds from −A to A.

ekf.finding: The default confidence is 0.95 and the displayed ellipse uses the positional covariance.

scope: Supplementary source qualifications; not additional course coverage.
